## Re-indexing after extraction-quality changes (RFC-0020)

Code entities carry **qualified identities** `{repo}/{path}::{bare_name}` (the
`{repo}` is the stable-source-key). When the identity scheme changes — e.g.
upgrading to RFC-0020 Phase 1 — already-indexed entities keep their **legacy**
ids until the source is re-scanned. A re-scan is convergent: it upserts the
current qualified-id entities + relationships and retracts the prior document
graph's stale records.

**No re-embedding is needed.

## Re-indexing after extraction-quality changes (RFC-0020)

Code entities carry **qualified identities** `{repo}/{path}::{bare_name}` (the
`{repo}` is the stable-source-key). When the identity scheme changes — e.g.
upgrading to RFC-0020 Phase 1 — already-indexed entities keep their **legacy**
ids until the source is re-scanned. A re-scan is convergent: it upserts the
current qualified-id entities + relationships and retracts the prior document
graph's stale records.

**No re-embedding is needed.** Embeddings are `EmbeddingTargetType::Chunk`
(content-keyed), and the identity change touches only the graph layer (entities +
relationships), not chunk content. So re-scan rebuilds the graph; the 442k chunk
vectors persist unchanged. To extract a **concept sub-graph** from documents (the
LLM `extract-knowledge` op), run `engram-maintain --op extract-knowledge` (or the
`maintenance_run` MCP tool) after the scan — documents are chunks-only at ingest.

### T1: Callables retain behavior around nested declarations

**Depends on:** none

**Spec mapping:** AC2. **Mode:** TDD pure/adapter integration.

**Tests:**
- Exact checkout fixture retains fee, error branch and return in its outer unit.
- Nested TS/Rust/Python functions/methods retain full outer bodies, multiline signatures and qualified child anchors.
- Class/impl containers keep existing independent method extraction without full-container duplication.

**Approach:**
- Replace blanket `has_declaration_descendant` suppression in `core/code/src/parser/tree_sitter_chunker.rs` with explicit callable versus structural-container treatment in a focused helper.
- Extend `adapters/ingest/tests/tree_sitter_chunker.rs` and focused code parser tests; leave public record fields unchanged in this independently shippable correction.

**Done when:** construction fixtures pass and a built live scan demonstrates the restored outer source. This task does not claim snapshot/whole-file coverage.
---
### Never do

- Reduce an executable outer function to its signature because it has nested declarations.
- Claim a reconstructed complete snapshot proves complete semantic extraction.
- Embed/index raw snapshots through any normal candidate feed, including dedup reuse.
- Introduce code-specific persistence into a memory/vector adapter, core SQL,
  a new core facade or a monolithic scanner/generation manager.
- Treat missing generation/role on legacy chunks as a complete new source view.
- Advertise cross-store ACID, undo already-succeeded writes as rollback, or
  hide a file write/cleanup failure by stamping it unchanged.
